import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def setup():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "t", "o", "T1", "B1", None),
        (2, "t", "o", "T2", "B2", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
        (3, "other", "o", "T3", "B3", None),       # cross-tenant
        (4, "t", "someone", "T4", "B4", None),     # cross-owner
        (5, "t", "o", "O'Brien \"x\"", "B5", None),
        (6, "t", "o'x", "T6", "B6", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

def test_get_document_access():
    c = setup()
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "T1", "body": "B1"}
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None      # deleted
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None      # cross-tenant
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None      # cross-owner
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None     # missing
    assert get_document(c, "other", "o", 3) == {"id": 3, "title": "T3", "body": "B3"}

def test_list_documents_access():
    c = setup()
    assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
        {"id": 1, "title": "T1", "body": "B1"},
        {"id": 5, "title": "O'Brien \"x\"", "body": "B5"},
    ]
    assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'x") == [{"id": 6, "title": "T6", "body": "B6"}]
    assert list_documents(c, "t", "nobody") == []
    assert list_documents(c, "missing", "o") == []

def test_quotes_are_bound_not_interpolated():
    c = setup()
    assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o", 1) is None
    assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o' OR '1'='1") == []

def test_result_keys_unchanged():
    c = setup()
    assert set(get_document(c, "t", "o", 1).keys()) == {"id", "title", "body"}
    assert all(set(d.keys()) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for name, fn in list(globals().items()):
        if name.startswith("test_") and callable(fn):
            fn()
            print("ok", name)
